pipeline.label: Figma manifest export
pipeline.role: Ground truth — node.type (TEXT, VECTOR, ELLIPSE, …). Images only via IMAGE fills / imageHash.

pipeline.label: manifestToContract adapter
pipeline.role: Must preserve manifest node kinds — TEXT stays layer.text, no PNG stamping.

pipeline.label: Contract on disk
pipeline.role: Must match adapter output. If kinds differ from manifest → fix adapter or remove post-adapter mutator.

pipeline.label: Live test harness
pipeline.role: Runs adapter + sends contract to Figma. Must NOT call applyLiveHebrewTextRasters / applyStorybookReferenceRasters on vsFigmaLive.

pipeline.label: Figma live importer
pipeline.role: Renders contract as Figma nodes — only when contract kinds are correct.

agent.rootCause: resolveFont for fig-85 Hebrew RTL label (Open Sans SemiBold) falls through to Latin Open Sans via familyCandidates at line 1095 when the Open Sans Hebrew branch misses, garbling glyphs and inflating naturalW so pinFigmaFlexCrossEndBareText shifts the user-header text cluster left of the avatar.
agent.primaryEdit: code-v2.ts — resolveFont — guard Hebrew Open Sans TEXT from Latin familyCandidates fallthrough; return nearest Open Sans Hebrew style instead
agent.resolution: Prior hypothesis WRONG: pinFigmaFlexCrossEndBareText textAlignHorizontal patches (5 attempts) did not move metrics — lines 887–908 already set textDirection RTL and textAlignHorizontal RIGHT for rtl/right/end. ONE edit in resolveFont lines 1072–1094: after the hasHebrew && ds.figmaFontFamily === "Open Sans" loop (families=["Open Sans Hebrew"], figmaStyleAliases on SemiBold, pickNearestInFamily), add an early return so Hebrew Open Sans never reaches familyCandidates(text.font) at line 1095 — e.g. if hasHebrew && ds.figmaFontFamily === "Open Sans", return pickNearestInFamily("Open Sans Hebrew") ?? first available Open Sans Hebrew style, or filter "Open Sans" out of candidates when text contains Hebrew. Contract fig-85 "שם משתמש:" has direction rtl, align right, figmaFontStyle SemiBold; fig-86 Inter email should re-pin correctly once Hebrew naturalW is fixed. Do NOT edit pinFigmaFlexCrossEndBareText. Leave pagination-footer and phone-row untouched.
